2.4. At least five years assessing online systems, portals, or dashboards, to determine compatibility and feasibility of connecting with other online systems.

jobs.title: Sr. Network Enterprise Architect
jobs.description:
Hello All,
Hope you are doing well
 
Position: Sr. Network Enterprise Architect
Location: Sacramento, CA
Duration: Long Term
 
Note: Must reside in California. Sacramento area is preferred but not required. Hybrid work, some on-site meetings may be required by client.
 
Position Overview
We are seeking a highly experienced Network Enterprise Architect to lead the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise-scale network infrastructure solutions. This role is responsible for delivering secure, scalable, and highly available network architectures across on-premises and cloud environments.
 
Key Responsibilities
Network Architecture & Strategy


Lead the architectural design of secure, scalable, and highly available network solutions


Develop network design alternatives including cloud connectivity, VPCs, segmentation, routing, and load balancing


Collaborate with cloud architects and security teams to align network strategy with enterprise standards


 
Solution Design & Engineering


Design and implement enterprise network architectures across hybrid and cloud environments


Configure and optimize networking components to meet performance and availability requirements


Ensure alignment with enterprise security policies and standards


 
Security & Compliance


Design and implement network security controls and frameworks


Ensure compliance with state and regulatory requirements for sensitive data


Apply best practices for secure network design in cloud and hybrid environments


 
Operations & Optimization


Support performance monitoring and optimization of network infrastructure


Identify and resolve network bottlenecks and reliability issues


Ensure high availability and fault-tolerant network design


 
Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement


Provide technical leadership, mentorship, and knowledge transfer to internal teams


Lead architecture reviews and present designs to stakeholders


Participate in executive and project governance meetings


 
Documentation


Produce and maintain high-quality network architecture documentation


Ensure documentation aligns with enterprise standards and project requirements


 
Required Qualifications


10+ years of progressive experience in network engineering and architecture roles, including 5+ years in enterprise-level design


3+ years of experience as lead architect in at least two major public cloud environments


Experience leading at least 3 large-scale network architecture projects


4+ years of experience in network security and compliance


3+ years of hands-on experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools


Expert-level cloud networking certification


Strong documentation skills (work samples required)


Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, or related field
